well_summary: The SILVER BIRCH KINDERSLEY 4-9-27-21W3M well was spud on August 01, 2026 at 06:30 hours and reached a total depth of 1620.00m on August 04, 2026 at 15:10 hours. The well is a directional well and targeted the DINA.

The drilling contractor was Precision Drilling and Mostar Directional provided directional services. Geological supervision was provided by Grace Okafor, P.Geo and Ben Larocque on behalf of Chinook Consulting Services.

The well was drilled from surface location 16-9-027-21W3M. Surface coordinates were 240.0m North of South, 310.0m East of West boundary of section 9-27-21W3, situated at a ground level elevation of 695.00m (Reference: Sea Level). Bottomhole coordinates were 65.0m South, 540.0m West of surface location at a true vertical depth (TVD) of 361.78m from kelly bushing (699.50m). Total depth was reached at 1620.0m, in the WATROUS.
A total of 2 drilling bits were used to drill the well, with a cumulative drill time of 32.00 hours, resulting in an average penetration rate of 50.6m/hr.

Total gas was monitored using a Pason Gas Analyzer gas detector. Drill cutting samples were collected over the interval 500 to 1000m, 5m intervals, 1000 to 1620m, 15m intervals for Silver Birch Petroleum Ltd. and none required for the SEM.
Wireline logs were not run. MWD Gamma was recorded.

formation_evaluation: Objectives: The primary objective of the SILVER BIRCH KINDERSLEY 4-9-27-21W3M well was the DINA Formation.

It was encountered at a measured depth of 457.68m (True Vertical Depth 372.75m, Subsea 326.75m). MWD Gamma confirmed the top of the formation at measured depth of 457.68m (True Vertical Depth 372.75m, Subsea 326.75m).
The SILVER BIRCH KINDERSLEY 4-9-27-21W3M well was completed as a cased directional DINA crude oil production well.
